summary: A row of controls that is one stop in the Tab order; the arrow keys move among them.

orientation.description: vertical stacks the controls, and the up and down arrows move among them.

root.note: A row of the author's controls with ui-geometry's gap for grouped controls. It paints nothing.

keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: Move focus to the next or the previous control, following the writing direction, and wrap.
keys.Home, End: Move focus to the first or the last control.
keys.Tab: Enters at the control that last had focus, and leaves with the next press.

guidance.text: The author names the toolbar with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

Its controls are the elements inside it that have the button, checkbox, switch or link role, a native button or a native link among them. A control that uses the arrow keys itself, such as a radio group or a text field, does not belong in a toolbar yet.

notYet: A control inside it that uses the arrow keys itself.
